supplement_text_draft: Proposal vocabulary (integration proposal v1): one uniform update action covers ALL updatable entities — infer the entity kind from the handle prefix and use ONLY the statuses legal for that kind: Q* questions: open|in_progress|answered|unresolved|blocked|deferred|superseded (answered REQUIRES disposition supported|not_supported|inconclusive|unavailable|not_applicable; unresolved requires basis + limitations + investigated_summary; blocked requires blocker; superseded requires superseded_by_handle Q*; required questions cannot be deferred and need a passed closure verification); E* evidence: irrelevant|potentially_relevant|relevant; H* hypotheses: active|supported|weakened|rejected|retired; X* contradictions: open|resolved|explained|unresolved; COV* coverage: not_started|in_progress|covered|partial|unavailable|not_applicable. Field-to-kind map for update: disposition/limitations/investigated_summary/blocker/superseded_by_handle are QUESTION-only; resolution_basis_handles/attempted_resolution/impact are CONTRADICTION-only; capability_basis is COVERAGE-only; related_question_handles are E*/COV*-only; basis_handles are E*-handles for Q* closure. basis_handles: [] means 'no basis' and is rejected wherever basis is required; omitting the field keeps the current value. Unknown or zero-domain handles and unavailable actions are rejected exactly as the v2 contract.
